CLAIM: Regional crop and irrigation planning is multi-institutional decision support, not direct command over farmer allocations.
SOURCE_TITLE: Gore Piura aprueba calendario oficial de la Campana Agricola Grande 2025-2026 de arroz y algodon
SPATIAL_UNIT: Agencia Agraria Piura / committee / user commissions
EVIDENCE_FINDING: The calendar was adopted by the PCR committee with ANA, SENAMHI, SENASA, INIA, PECHP, Juntas and Comisiones de Usuarios; user commissions communicate technical dispositions to associates.
LIMITATION: Does not show that one regional planner commands all farmer crop choices.
NOTES: Supports NORMATIVE_REGIONAL_DECISION_SUPPORT.

CLAIM: PCR approval is a regional legal/planning process for irrigated areas of irrigation districts.
SOURCE_TITLE: Resolucion Directoral Regional N. 395-2025/Gobierno Regional Piura-DRA-DR
SPATIAL_UNIT: Irrigated area of district/subdistrict of irrigation and Agencias Agrarias
EVIDENCE_FINDING: The resolution cites PCR formulation for irrigated areas of a district of irrigation and approves a regional plan by agency areas.
LIMITATION: Does not create district UBIGEO crop maxima and does not prove centralized command authority.
NOTES: PDF was scanned; visual inspection of pages 5-8 was used.

CLAIM: Water planning is participatory and multisectoral.
SOURCE_TITLE: ANA aprueba plan hidrico para garantizar el abastecimiento multisectorial en el sistema Chira Piura
SPATIAL_UNIT: Hydraulic system Chira Piura / provinces Piura and Sechura
EVIDENCE_FINDING: ANA describes the PADH as joint work among user organizations, operators and local authorities.
LIMITATION: System planning does not identify district crop allocation authority.
NOTES: Supports governance context only.

CLAIM: AREA_HA in land_physical.csv represents physical agricultural footprint by district.
SOURCE_TITLE: Mapa Nacional de Superficie Agricola 2024 as processed in land_physical.csv
EVIDENCE_FINDING: The local frozen table has 61 district rows and 706379.292651 ha sourced to interpretation of Planet and Google Earth imagery by DGESEP-MIDAGRI.
LIMITATION: Physical agricultural footprint is not the same as currently cultivated, irrigated, expansion, or freely reallocable area.
NOTES: Candidate land-capacity ceiling only under a physical-footprint interpretation.

CLAIM: MNSA is a statistical reference map, not proof of freely reallocable land.
SOURCE_TITLE: MIDAGRI publica actualizacion del Mapa Nacional de Superficie Agricola
EVIDENCE_FINDING: MIDAGRI states the MNSA groups permanent crops, transient crops, fallow/rest, cultivated and uncultivated agricultural lands and is used for SIEA statistical operations.
LIMITATION: The source does not identify crop-specific reallocable area or expansion area.
NOTES: Critical warning: physical agricultural area equals freely reallocable land is FALSE.

CLAIM: RM 0026-2025 updates the MNSA by department, province and district and makes it referential for SIEA statistical use.
SOURCE_TITLE: Resolucion Ministerial N. 0026-2025-MIDAGRI
EVIDENCE_FINDING: Article 1 updates the MNSA by department, province and district; Article 2 states it is referential for SIEA statistical use.
LIMITATION: Referential statistical use is not a legal land-allocation maximum.
NOTES: PDF was scanned; visual inspection confirmed article text.

CLAIM: Frozen panel_master provides historical district-crop-year area variables for the five target crops.
SOURCE_TITLE: panel_master.csv target-crop inventory
EVIDENCE_FINDING: Target coverage: rice 340 rows/46 districts; maize amarillo duro 405/55; mango 255/36; limon 311/44; banana 390/54.
LIMITATION: Historical observed rows are not current land capacity and do not prove free reallocation.
NOTES: Uses C0B local inventory only, not C0A adjudication.

CLAIM: Raw agricultural QA supports monthly source coverage and ANO-MES integrity for upstream agricultural records.
SOURCE_TITLE: raw_agricultural_audit.json
EVIDENCE_FINDING: QA reports 124514 raw rows, 96 crops, 55 raw districts, first month 2015-08, last month 2024-12 and zero ANO-MES mismatches.
LIMITATION: This is source coverage evidence, not decision feasibility by itself.
NOTES: Upstream file was read only.

CLAIM: SIEMBRA and COSECHA are transient flow-like area measures; perennial installed stock evidence remains separate.
SOURCE_TITLE: panel_master.csv columns and phenology windows
EVIDENCE_FINDING: The frozen data expose SOWN_AREA, HARVEST_AREA and VERDE_ACTUAL separately; phenology freezes rice and maize as sowing-cohort architectures and mango/limon/banana as perennial or continuous architectures.
LIMITATION: VERDE_ACTUAL is not accepted as hectares in C0B without independent unit support.
NOTES: C0B does not import C0A unit adjudications.

CLAIM: PCR 2025-2026 reports programmed regional agricultural areas by crop group and agency.
SOURCE_TITLE: Resolucion Directoral Regional N. 395-2025/Gobierno Regional Piura-DRA-DR
EVIDENCE_FINDING: The annex summary reports 259690 ha total: 73927 permanent, 59925 semipermanent, 125838 transient; agency totals include Piura 33933, Chulucanas 57921, San Lorenzo 54264, Chira 59064, Huancabamba 21730, Huarmaca 12659 and Ayabaca 20119 ha.
LIMITATION: Agency areas are not UBIGEO district areas and are not automatic legal maxima.
NOTES: PDF was scanned; visual inspection of page 8 was used.

CLAIM: PCR 2024-2025 reports prior programmed regional agricultural areas by crop group and agency.
SOURCE_TITLE: Resolucion Directoral Regional N. 285-2024/Gobierno Regional Piura-DRA-DR
EVIDENCE_FINDING: The resolution reports 291633 ha total: 78946 permanent, 62288 semipermanent and 150399 transient by agency.
LIMITATION: Does not establish district-level maxima or farmer-level obligations.
NOTES: PDF was scanned; visual inspection of pages 3-4 was used.

CLAIM: PCR 2025-2026 annex identifies all five target crops at agency resolution.
SOURCE_TITLE: Anexo 01 Programacion de Siembras Campana Agricola 2025-2026
EVIDENCE_FINDING: Visual inspection identified rice 51527 ha, maize amarillo duro 15384 ha, mango 30842 ha, limon sutil 18555 ha, platano organico 8115 ha and platano convencional 5694 ha.
LIMITATION: Crop programming is agency-level and cannot be used as district constraints without spatial adjudication.
NOTES: Figures are evidence reconnaissance only.

CLAIM: Chira-Piura PADH 2025-2026 gives system-level multisectoral water availability and agrarian allocation.
SOURCE_TITLE: ANA aprueba plan hidrico para garantizar el abastecimiento multisectorial en el sistema Chira Piura
SPATIAL_UNIT: Hydraulic system Chira Piura / provinces Piura and Sechura
EVIDENCE_FINDING: ANA reports projected availability 3630.69 Hm3, consumptive demand 2149.53 Hm3 and agrarian allocation 2073.14 Hm3.
LIMITATION: Not a district-level crop water constraint; no allocation weights are authorized.
NOTES: Critical warning: district division by area share is NOT_AUTHORIZED.

CLAIM: PCR 2025-2026 relies on multiple ANA PADH approvals for Alto Piura, Chira Piura and San Lorenzo systems.
SOURCE_TITLE: Resolucion Directoral Regional N. 395-2025/Gobierno Regional Piura-DRA-DR
EVIDENCE_FINDING: The resolution cites ANA resolutions approving PADH for hydraulic systems relevant to Alto Piura, Chira Piura and San Lorenzo.
LIMITATION: System references do not produce a UBIGEO district crosswalk.
NOTES: Confirms water architecture is multi-system.

CLAIM: Piura contains multiple hydraulic systems, not only Poechos/Chira-Piura.
SOURCE_TITLE: Oportunidad de aprovechamiento y uso - Infraestructura hidraulica
EVIDENCE_FINDING: The CRHC page lists three systems in its area: Sistema Hidraulico Chira Piura, Sistema Hidraulico San Lorenzo and Sistema Hidraulico Alto Piura.
LIMITATION: Does not map each UBIGEO district to hydraulic service areas.
NOTES: Critical warning: Poechos represents all Piura districts is FALSE.

CLAIM: San Lorenzo has a distinct hydraulic planning process and reservoir evidence.
SOURCE_TITLE: Piura: inician estudio para evaluar la capacidad de almacenamiento del reservorio San Lorenzo
SPATIAL_UNIT: Reservorio San Lorenzo / Junta de Usuarios San Lorenzo
EVIDENCE_FINDING: ANA states a bathymetric study in San Lorenzo will support PADH planning and water distribution among uses.
LIMITATION: Does not provide district crop water allocations.
NOTES: Confirms San Lorenzo cannot be collapsed into Poechos.

CLAIM: Chira-Piura, San Lorenzo, Medio/Bajo Piura, Alto Piura, Sechura and Chira user organizations appear as distinct operational actors.
SOURCE_TITLE: Minagri: Agro Rural y Junta de Usuarios de Piura muestran avances en descolmatacion de canales y drenes
EVIDENCE_FINDING: The official note names user-board actors for Alto Piura, San Lorenzo, Medio y Bajo Piura, Sechura and Chira.
LIMITATION: Does not provide a geospatial service-area to district crosswalk.
NOTES: Used only as supporting context.

CLAIM: No official district allocation rule for system-level PADH water was identified in C0B.0.
SOURCE_TITLE: PADH and repository inventory for water-to-district linkage
EVIDENCE_FINDING: Available official evidence is at hydraulic-system, agency or user-organization scale; no reproducible UBIGEO district allocation weights were accepted.
LIMITATION: Major future model-design limitation: relationship remains UNKNOWN and likely many-to-many.
NOTES: No area-share, crop-share, population-share or equal-division allocation is authorized.

CLAIM: PCR agency areas are not district UBIGEO crosswalks.
SOURCE_TITLE: PCR 2025-2026 and PCR 2024-2025 annexes
EVIDENCE_FINDING: PCR annexes organize crop programs by Agencias Agrarias and crop groups/crops.
LIMITATION: A separate official agency-to-district or irrigation-service-area crosswalk is required before district constraints.
NOTES: Classified CROSSWALK_REQUIRED for model use.

CLAIM: PCR 2024 distinguishes coast agencies with water-balance support from sierra agencies whose agriculture depends on rainfall.
SOURCE_TITLE: Resolucion Directoral Regional N. 285-2024/Gobierno Regional Piura-DRA-DR
EVIDENCE_FINDING: Visual inspection confirms the plan says coast agencies are sustained by hydric-balance analysis, while sierra agencies do not present a water balance and their crop installation/growth is linked to rainfall.
LIMITATION: Does not identify irrigated/rainfed hectares by UBIGEO and crop.
NOTES: Critical warning: all agricultural land in Piura is irrigated is UNRESOLVED/FALSE as a blanket assumption.

CLAIM: MNSA land area does not identify irrigated service area or rainfed status.
SOURCE_TITLE: MIDAGRI MNSA 2024 / RM 0026-2025-MIDAGRI
EVIDENCE_FINDING: MNSA supplies district agricultural surface, but C0B.0 found no irrigated/rainfed split in the local land_physical artifact.
LIMITATION: Cannot infer all agricultural hectares are irrigated.
NOTES: Requires official irrigation-service-area or rainfed-land crosswalk.

CLAIM: FAO56 provides technical method evidence for crop evapotranspiration and crop coefficients.
SOURCE_TITLE: Crop evapotranspiration - Guidelines for computing crop water requirements - FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56
EVIDENCE_FINDING: FAO56 is a technical standard for computing reference and crop evapotranspiration from weather data and crop coefficients.
LIMITATION: It is not an official Piura allocation rule and coefficients were not constructed in C0B.0.
NOTES: May support sensitivity design only after local climate/crop/soil linkage.

CLAIM: Crop water need depends on climate, crop type and growth stage; local duration data are preferred.
SOURCE_TITLE: Chapter 2: Crop water needs
EVIDENCE_FINDING: FAO states crop water need depends on climate, crop type and growth stage; examples cover maize, paddy rice, banana and citrus-like crops and note local growing-period data are preferable.
LIMITATION: Mango and limon would still require local Piura agronomic adaptation; no coefficients are frozen.
NOTES: Cannot become a hard district water constraint in C0B.0.

CLAIM: PCR 2025 classifies mango and limon under permanent crops and platano under semipermanent crops.
SOURCE_TITLE: Anexo 01 Programacion de Siembras Campana Agricola 2025-2026
EVIDENCE_FINDING: Visual inspection of PCR annex places mango and limon sutil in C. permanentes and platano convencional/organico in C. semi-permanentes.
LIMITATION: Classification supports inertia but not numerical adjustment percentages.
NOTES: No delta_P or delta_A is set.

CLAIM: Frozen phenology architecture distinguishes transient cohort crops from perennial/continuous crops.
SOURCE_TITLE: phenology_windows_frozen.csv
EVIDENCE_FINDING: Rice and maize amarillo duro are sowing-cohort weighted; mango is seasonal perennial; limon is recurrent perennial broad; banana is multistage continuous.
LIMITATION: This is architecture evidence, not a land-adjustment coefficient.
NOTES: Upstream phenology was read only.

CLAIM: Current installed crop stock is not fully certified for district crop constraints.
SOURCE_TITLE: panel_master.csv VERDE_ACTUAL inventory
EVIDENCE_FINDING: VERDE_ACTUAL is present and positive for most perennial/semipermanent target rows, but C0B.0 does not independently certify its physical unit as hectares.
LIMITATION: Cannot be used silently as installed hectares.
NOTES: Requires independent C0B evidence before hard inertia constraints.

CLAIM: Historical area changes could support empirical calibration later but do not provide official bounds.
SOURCE_TITLE: panel_master.csv historical target-crop areas
EVIDENCE_FINDING: Observed SIEMBRA/HARVEST_AREA/VERDE_ACTUAL history can be used to study empirical changes after a separate protocol.
LIMITATION: No bound is estimated in C0B.0 and historical changes may reflect shocks, reporting and market responses.
NOTES: Future bounds are EMPIRICALLY_CALIBRATED or SENSITIVITY_ONLY, not direct official.

CLAIM: PCR 2024 and 2025 programs show campaign-to-campaign changes at agency/category scale.
SOURCE_TITLE: PCR 2024-2025 and PCR 2025-2026 regional annex summaries
EVIDENCE_FINDING: Programmed totals differ between 291633 ha in 2024-2025 and 259690 ha in 2025-2026, with category and agency detail.
LIMITATION: This is planning evidence, not a validated adjustment-capacity constraint.
NOTES: Can inform future sensitivity ranges only after crosswalk.

CLAIM: The frozen panel includes farm-gate price information but not production cost, gross margin, net return or profit.
SOURCE_TITLE: panel_master.csv economic fields inventory
EVIDENCE_FINDING: The local panel contains PRECIO and production/area fields, but no cost, margin, profit or return fields.
LIMITATION: C0B.0 does not build GVP or monetary outcomes and does not authorize profit optimization.
NOTES: Future objective support is weak unless cost evidence is added.

CLAIM: Official operational cost evidence for all five target crops and Piura was not established in C0B.0.
SOURCE_TITLE: Official cost-source reconnaissance
EVIDENCE_FINDING: C0B.0 found price/proxy and scattered program/business-plan style evidence but no reproducible complete cost-budget source covering all five crops at Piura district scale.
LIMITATION: Net-return or profit objective is unsupported at this stage.
NOTES: Only gross-revenue or area-risk objectives could be explored later with explicit caveats; none is built now.

CLAIM: District-level strategic allocation is more defensible than parcel-level layout.
SOURCE_TITLE: C0B spatial-scale synthesis from land, PCR and hydraulic-system evidence
EVIDENCE_FINDING: Land and panel data are district-coded, while PCR and water evidence are agency/system coded; no parcel geometries or parcel-level farmer decision data are present.
LIMITATION: District scale still requires crosswalks for water/PCR evidence.
NOTES: Parcel-level precision is excluded.

CLAIM: Official evidence confirms mismatches among districts, Agencias Agrarias, hydraulic systems, Juntas and commissions.
SOURCE_TITLE: CRHC hydraulic systems plus PCR annexes
EVIDENCE_FINDING: CRHC describes multiple hydraulic systems; PCR reports by agencies; local data use UBIGEO districts.
LIMITATION: Crosswalks are required before converting institutional evidence into district constraints.
NOTES: Relationship is not one-to-one by default.
